company.description: Name of the company or store issuing the invoice or receipt
company.format: keep the full name exactly as printed

date.format: keep the original format as printed on the document

address.description: Company or store address. Return null if the document does not include an address field.
address.format: keep the address exactly as printed; null if absent

total.description: Total payable amount (grand total, including tax if shown)
total.format: keep the original currency symbol and number format if present
